prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-definition professional fashion editorial photograph of a sophisticated clearly adult woman with a sleek center-parted bun. She wears elegant thin-rimmed silver glasses and a minimalist white long-sleeved silk blouse with softly gathered sleeves. She is posed gracefully with her hands near her face and upper chest, showcasing a luxury silver watch. The background is clean bright white with bold high-contrast black serif typography reading VOGUE at the top. Use precise diffused softbox lighting, soft skin texture, sharp focus on the eyes, metallic highlights on the glasses and watch, an 85mm lens for flattering portrait compression, 8k resolution, restrained contrast, and fine editorial film grain.
